content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have six networked [product_name] controllers with mixed [version_no] firmware versions. Controller 3 ([version_no]) sends a signal over the network to controller 6 ([version_no]) to switch output Q2. Output Q2 on controller 6 switches on and off every 3-5 minutes even though its input signal is continuously active. When tested in online mode (screenshots attached), the network signal from controller 3 remains active (indicated red), but the input signal to controller 6 alternates between active and inactive (red and black). Network tests over 15 minutes show no packet loss. Can anyone explain why the input signal to controller 6 keeps switching, despite the network signal from controller 3 staying on? Thank you in advance.

Which firmware version do you have on [product_name] [version_no]? The latest is [version_no]. If your device doesn't have this version, please update the firmware. You can download the update from: [document]
I'm updating the firmware, but I couldn't find a checksum link to verify the software at the provided link. Where should I look for this? Thanks.
Unsure on that. Please submit a support request to [company_name].

I've updated the firmware on Controller 3. Here are the controller firmware versions: Controller 1: [version_no], Controller 2: [version_no], Controller 3: [version_no], Controller 4: [version_no], Controller 5: [version_no], Controller 6: [version_no]. The problem still remains. I haven't updated Controller 5 yet, but it doesn't impact the involved controllers. Any suggestions on how to proceed?
No other suggestions. Submit a support request and contact [company_name] directly.
Controller 5 updated to [version_no]. No change; the issue persists.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing unreliable network transmission between interconnected [product_name] controllers running multiple firmware versions. Efforts to address this through firmware upgrades have not resolved the issue, and the network itself appears stable. User confusion remains as no solution has been identified—even after firmware updates and network troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects dependable network communication and digital output performance between [product_name] controllers with different firmware versions, along with straightforward troubleshooting recommendations to fix persistent output switching issues.
